question: Should ClawHub own a permanent runtime promotions platform, including public/admin APIs, hosted feed contracts, homepage cards, and production deploy publishing?
rationale: The PR is a broad new product and release surface rather than a narrow bug fix, so maintainer intent is needed before the new public/admin contract and deployment workflow become permanent.

options.title: Accept Core Promotions
options.body: Proceed after safe deploy-path verification because promotions become a first-class ClawHub platform surface.

options.title: Keep Draft Pending Direction
options.body: Leave the branch open while maintainers decide whether promotions belong in core and how launch pages or OpenClaw CLI consumption should ship.

options.title: Pause Or Close
options.body: Do not add the platform surface if promotions should remain external campaign or plugin/bundle content instead of core ClawHub state.

recommendation.title: Accept Core Promotions
recommendation.body: Proceed after safe deploy-path verification because promotions become a first-class ClawHub platform surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing hosted-feed, production deploy, and management baseline this PR extends traces most strongly to Patrick Erichsen in current-main history.
